item.description: Srinagar, Feb 5: The Economic Offences Wing (EOW) of crime branch Jammu and Kashmir has filed a chargesheet against a former assistant professor for hiding her foreign nationality in her application for the post in a medical college. item.title: Over 100 Boxes Of Explosives Seized From Pick-Up Van In Kerala’s Palakkad
item.description: PALAKKAD, Feb 5: A pick-up van carrying more than 100 boxes of explosives have been seized near Palakkad town area in Kerala, the police said. An officer of the Palakkad Town South police station said they found over 100 boxes of gelatin sticks and more than 20 boxes of detonators in the vehicle.
